sentences.en: The new gym includes modern running facilities like treadmills and elliptical machines.
sentences.zh: 这家新健身房配备了如跑步机和椭圆机之类的先进跑步设施。

sentences.en: Our community center has a variety of outdoor running facilities for residents to use free of charge.
sentences.zh: 我们社区中心为居民提供免费使用的各种户外跑步设施。

sentences.en: The school is renovating its existing running facilities to improve student health and fitness levels.
sentences.zh: 学校正在翻新现有的跑步设施，以提高学生的健康和体能水平。
